name: tmux

1.how: tmux new-session -d -s <name> | send-keys -t <name> -l <text> | send-keys Enter | capture-pane -p -t <name> -S -N | list-sessions | kill-session
1.notes: The transport behind maus term *. Text in, text out, no vision.

1.how: tmux -C (control mode): a line protocol with %output notifications per pane
1.notes: Phase 1 observation source: every command and its output, live.

quirks: Sessions created by MausOS are named maus-<name> so the user can attach to them in any terminal.
